ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (dark) to 35% high-intensity (white/cream) pixel distribution; sharp contrast boundaries between the central dark field and lateral light zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity blobs located at the lateral extremities of both lobes. The right lobe features a solid, roughly triangular cream-colored region. The left lobe features an elongated high-intensity region with significant low-intensity mottling along the inferior border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an obtuse interior angle; depth is roughly 5-8% of the total fluke height from the leading edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible trailing edge; peaks are more pronounced and jagged toward the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips; right lobe displays a slightly more acute sweep toward the tip compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple punctate high-intensity clusters (white-on-black) visible on the lower ventral surface of the left lobe and the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct thin, light-colored linear marks visible against the dark field of the right lobe; several faint horizontal disruptions visible within the high-intensity zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and possible minor tissue loss at the distal tip of the left lobe; dense dark mottling within the cream-colored regions suggesting localized pigmentation variance or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellow-tan hue present within the high-intensity lateral zones, contrasting with the stark white pixels found at the extreme edges.
